chunks: every one has to meet what he wishes to avoid by running away.
Death is the place to which life is driving. To run away from it means to catch it.
How many days did I spend in searching for the secret of this matter, but Allāh did not allow save its concealment.
Alas! It is a treasured knowledge.

key_terms.الْأَجَلُ: Death or the appointed term of life
key_terms.مَسَاقُ: The place to which something is driven or directed

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'al-ajal masaq al-nafs' in Imam Ali's last will?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the metaphysical nature of death (al-ajal) as the inherent trajectory of the soul, where the act of fleeing merely accelerates its encounter. He further reveals the esoteric dimension of this reality, noting that despite his profound inquiry into the 'hidden secret' of divine decree, God willed its concealment, characterizing it as a treasured, reserved knowledge (ilm makhzun) known only to the elect.
